description: This file defines the SystemInfo class and related functions for retrieving system information such as memory, CPU load, environment variables, and system metadata within the WPEFramework project. It includes declarations for external functions, constants, and a nested MemorySnapshot class, serving as an interface for system-related data access.

classes.name: SystemInfo
classes.description: Provides static and instance methods to retrieve system information such as memory, CPU load, environment variables, and system metadata. Contains a nested MemorySnapshot class for JSON representation of memory stats.

classes.name: SystemInfo::MemorySnapshot
classes.description: Encapsulates a snapshot of system memory information, providing a method to output the data as a JSON string.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Id
methods.description: Generates a unique identifier based on raw device ID and key length.

methods.name: SystemInfo::GetEnvironment
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an environment variable.

methods.name: SystemInfo::SetEnvironment
methods.description: Sets the value of an environment variable, with an option to force the change.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Instance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the SystemInfo class.

methods.name: SystemInfo::~SystemInfo
methods.description: Destructor for the SystemInfo class.

methods.name: SystemInfo::SetTime
methods.description: Sets the system time.

methods.name: SystemInfo::SetTimeZone
methods.description: Sets the system time zone.

methods.name: SystemInfo::GetHostName
methods.description: Returns the hostname of the system.

methods.name: SystemInfo::GetTotalRam
methods.description: Returns total RAM in bytes.

methods.name: SystemInfo::GetPageSize
methods.description: Returns the system's memory page size.

methods.name: SystemInfo::GetPhysicalPageCount
methods.description: Calculates the number of physical memory pages.

methods.name: SystemInfo::GetUpTime
methods.description: Returns system uptime in seconds.

methods.name: SystemInfo::GetFreeRam
methods.description: Returns free RAM in bytes.

methods.name: SystemInfo::GetTotalSwap
methods.description: Returns total swap space in bytes.

methods.name: SystemInfo::GetFreeSwap
methods.description: Returns free swap space in bytes.

methods.name: SystemInfo::GetCpuLoad
methods.description: Returns current CPU load.

methods.name: SystemInfo::GetCpuLoadAvg
methods.description: Returns an array of CPU load averages.

methods.name: SystemInfo::TakeMemorySnapshot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of current memory usage.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Ticks
methods.description: Returns a high-resolution timestamp.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Architecture
methods.description: Returns the system architecture string.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Chipset
methods.description: Returns the chipset information.

methods.name: SystemInfo::FirmwareVersion
methods.description: Returns the firmware version.
